== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early sideways Light box says ‘Once per turn, may ▼ a medical droid here.’ Later says ‘During your deploy phase, may ▼ a medical droid here.’ The specified timing changes. The Dark text and Force-icon layout inherit the unchanged Decipher site; later full witnesses confirm its Force drain plus one with an Imperial present when controlled. Both keep the same deploy pull.
